definitions.explanation: In baseball, a base hit on which the batter safely reaches first base only. Contrasted with extra-base hits such as doubles and home runs.

examples.japanese: {単打|たんだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧{二本|にほん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{単打|たんだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{放|はな}った→放つ：10062_hanatsu⟧。
{満塁|まんるい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場面|ばめん}→場面：03702_bamen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{単打|たんだ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧、{二点|にてん}⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: With the bases loaded, a single came and two runs scored.

notes:
A baseball term for a hit that gets the batter only as far as first base.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {単打|たんだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧: to hit a single
- {単打|たんだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{放|はな}つ→放つ：10062_hanatsu⟧: to rap out a single

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{長打|ちょうだ}→長打：29466_chouda⟧: extra-base hit — a double, triple, or home run, the opposite of a single
- ⟦{安打|あんだ}→安打：19717_anda⟧: base hit — any hit, including singles and extra-base hits
